items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Yes, I know his grandchildren and his son. Yeah, George.

ctx.x: Oh, read. We had a professor. Uh huh. You understand your professor Hinger? Uh huh. Then I had a fellow up there and used to come home and teach. They called him, what is his name again? The name again. R.C.B.I. Creole for a trumpet player. He died. Yes. He used to teach down there. Old Jim Humphrey used to teach. You heard of Jim Humphrey?
Yes, I know his grandchildren and his son. Yeah, George.
Well, he taught all them bands down there.
